companyName: State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF
description: The State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before expenses, correspond generally to the price and yield performance of the Health Care Select Sector Index (the "Index").The Index seeks to provide an effective representation of the health care sector of the S&P 500 Index.Seeks to provide precise exposure to companies in the pharmaceuticals; health care equipment and supplies; health care providers and services; biotechnology; life sciences tools and services; and health care technology industries.Allows investors to take strategic or tactical positions at a more targeted level than traditional style based investing.
